scope: Declared passive text preview; MCQ, evidence selection, classification and open responses. Served UI, child difficulty and runtime marking are unqualified.
review: Solve without author keys first. Review candidate feedback, source relations and rubrics in separate stateless calls. Preserve all samples; any uncertainty, unavailable sample or contradiction vetoes a decisive criterion.
repetition: Fresh child processes with identical frozen packets, code and config. Report observed variation; model aliases do not establish an immutable serving revision.
